title: Perrigo Company plc 8-K — Segment Reporting Change
summary: Perrigo Company plc filed an 8-K announcing a change to its reporting segments, transitioning from a geographic structure to product-category based segments (Self Care, Specialty Care, Infant Formula) effective Q1 2026. The company also changed its primary segment profitability metric from operating income to adjusted operating income. This is a routine corporate disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Perrigo changed from geographic to product-category based segment reporting as of Q1 2026
New segments: Self Care (OTC health/wellness), Specialty Care (women's health, skin health), Infant Formula
Primary profitability metric changed from segment operating income to segment adjusted operating income
Recast financial information provided for Q1 2024 through Q4 2025
No impact on historical consolidated financial position, results of operations, or cash flows
Oral Care and Other (including Dermacosmetics) disclosed as 'All Other'
why_it_matters: This is a corporate accounting/segment reporting disclosure. It does not relate to monetary policy, interest rates, market structure, or macro economic catalysts. The filing is relevant only to Perrigo equity and debt investors tracking corporate restructuring disclosures.
